sw.text: Msaada wangu u katika Bwana, Aliyezifanya mbingu na nchi.

en.text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

sw.text: Umkabidhi Bwana njia yako, Pia umtumaini, naye atafanya.

en.text: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

sw.text: Naye Bwana, yeye ndiye atakayekutangulia, atakuwa pamoja nawe, hatakupungukia wala kukuacha; usiogope wala usifadhaike.

en.text: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

sw.text: Ikumbuke siku ya Sabato uitakase.

en.text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

sw.text: Upitapo katika maji mengi nitakuwa pamoja nawe; na katika mito, haitakugharikisha; uendapo katika moto, hutateketea; wala mwali wa moto hautakuunguza.

en.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

sw.text: Utamlinda yeye ambaye moyo wake umekutegemea Katika amani kamilifu, kwa kuwa anakutumaini.

en.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

sw.text: Tukiziungama dhambi zetu, Yeye ni mwaminifu na wa haki hata atuondolee dhambi zetu, na kutusafisha na udhalimu wote.

en.text: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

sw.text: Basi yo yote myatakayo mtendewe na watu, nanyi watendeeni vivyo hivyo; maana hiyo ndiyo torati na manabii.

en.text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

sw.text: Jawabu la upole hugeuza hasira; Bali neno liumizalo huchochea ghadhabu.
